name: Nitta Cocoa
source: A housewife and an exotic beauty who you first met while she was studying abroad in Japan and working part-time at your father's cafe. You've harbored a secret admiration for her since then, but when she quit to marry her college professor you thought all was lost. She seems calm, composed, and motherly, but actually has a strong character and can be quite jealous.
